jsonld.name: Paycheck Calculator
jsonld.description: Estimate your take-home pay per paycheck with 2026 federal tax brackets, Social Security and Medicare, state income tax, and pre-tax deductions like 401(k) and health insurance. Free, instant, no signup.

mainEntity.name: Which tax figures does this calculator use?

acceptedAnswer.text: 2026 federal tax brackets and standard deductions from IRS Rev. Proc. 2025-32, the 2026 Social Security wage base of $184,500, and Medicare at 1.45% plus 0.9% on wages above $200,000. State income tax uses a flat rate you choose, since state rules vary widely.

mainEntity.name: Where can I find my actual effective tax rate?

acceptedAnswer.text: Divide the total tax withheld on a recent pay stub or tax return by your gross income for that period — that gives a reasonably accurate personal effective rate to use here.
